tagline: One open corner to walk straight in, a bolster almost all round, and fleece where they land.
lead: Your dog walks straight in through an open corner and drops onto fleece, with an edge for their head.
value: A waterproof lining around the foam is the first thing cut at lower prices, and profiled foam the second. Aspen keeps both.
intro: Aspen is an orthopaedic chaise dog bed for small and medium dogs, with a profiled egg-crate foam core, a bolstered edge with one open corner, a fleece sleeping surface and a waterproof lining.
points: A chaise-style entry they can walk straight into.
An edge to lean into almost all the way round.
Profiled foam spreads their weight rather than compressing flat.
Soft fleece where they sleep, and a waterproof lining around the foam.
best_for: Small and medium dogs who would rather walk into a bed than step over a side, and like a head rest once down.
fit_note: One size, for small and medium dogs. The bolster takes up part of the outside footprint, so measure your dog curled up as well as stretched out. Ask us for exact measurements before you order.
care: Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. Wipe the lining. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Orthopaedic Chaise Dog Bed for Small & Medium Dogs | Snoozly
seo_description: Walk-in orthopaedic chaise dog bed for small and medium dogs: one open corner, a bolster almost all round. Egg-crate foam, fleece top, waterproof lining.
